name: Sparse Shadow Volume Raycast
definition: A hierarchical raycasting algorithm that traverses a sparse shadow volume texture (likely a sparse voxel octree or similar structure) to find the first intersection with a shadow-casting volume. It uses a multi-level approach, starting with a coarse search and refining based on occupancy bits.
summary: Sparse Shadow Volume Raycast is a hierarchical algorithm that dynamically adjusts step size and LOD based on occupancy bits to efficiently skip empty space in sparse textures.
